transcript.en: Conference Centre Reservations. Good morning.
transcript.zh: 会议中心预定处，早

transcript.en: Hi. I'm interested in the computing conference next month.
transcript.zh: 你好，我对下个月的计算机会议感兴趣。

transcript.en: Future Directions in Computing?
transcript.zh: 计算机的未来方向？

transcript.en: Yes, that's right.
transcript.zh: 没错。

transcript.en: Could I ask you a few questions about it?
transcript.zh: 我能就此问你几个问题吗？

transcript.en: Of course.
transcript.zh: 没问题。

transcript.en: OK. I know the conference is for three days but actually I want to attend on the Friday and Saturday only.
transcript.zh: 好的，我知道会议持续三天。但是事实上，我只想参加周五、周六的课程。

transcript.en: Will that work out to be any cheaper?
transcript.zh: 这样的话能更便宜点吗？

transcript.en: Let me have a look.
transcript.zh: 让我看看。

transcript.en: Well, you could register for the two days separately, but that wouldn't actually save you very much as it still costs ￡35 for each day.
transcript.zh: 你可以分别注册这两天的课程，但是并不能帮你省钱，因为这仍按照每天35英镑收费。

transcript.en: In fact, if you could register for the three days, you also get an invitation to a free dinner on the Saturday night, so that's probably the better option.
transcript.zh: 事实上，如果你注册三天的课程，你还可以在周六晚上得到免费晚餐的邀请函，所以这可能是更好的选择。

transcript.en: Right, I'll do that. How much will the fees be in that case?
transcript.zh: 好的，我会照着来的。这样的话要多少钱？

transcript.en: All right. I'd like to register for the full three days. Now, can I pay that by credit card?
transcript.zh: 好的，我要注册三天，能用信用卡吗？

transcript.en: I'm afraid not. You'll have to send a cheque to us, or you can pay at the conference office.
transcript.zh: 不可以，你得寄给我们支票，或者你可以到会议办公室付款。

transcript.en: Fine. So it's probably easiest if I pay by cheque.
transcript.zh: 好，如果我用支票的话会更容易一些。

transcript.en: Now then, what else do I need to arrange? Right.
transcript.zh: 现在我还需要安排什么？好的。

transcript.en: How about accommodation? I guess that's not included in the price?
transcript.zh: 住宿呢？费用不包括吧？

transcript.en: No, I'm sorry, it's not, but we do have a few rooms available for delegates at the conference centre if you'd like.
transcript.zh: 不，对不起。但是我们在会议中心有一些为代表们准备的房间，如果你想住的话。

transcript.en: Those are very cheap but if you're interested you'll need to book soon, because there's always a heavy demand for them.
transcript.zh: 非常便宜，但是如果你想要的话就得早点预定了，因为需求量总是很大。

transcript.en: They are only ￡15 per night, but they are very basic and you'd have to get your own breakfast, because they don't provide you with that.
transcript.zh: 每晚只需15英镑，但是设施很基础，你得自己准备早饭，因为他们不提供这些。

transcript.en: But it's very convenient, because it's in the same building as the conference rooms.
transcript.zh: 但是非常方便，因为它和会议室在同一座大楼里。

transcript.en: Uhuh.
transcript.zh: 额

transcript.en: Or there's a very reasonable guest house which is ￡25 per night.
transcript.zh: 还有一个价格很合理的客房，每晚25英镑。

transcript.en: And I think that includes your breakfast.
transcript.zh: 我想应该包含早餐，

transcript.en: Is it close to the conference centre?
transcript.zh: 距离会议中心近吗？

transcript.en: It would be about a ten-minute walk away from here.
transcript.zh: 步行十分钟

transcript.en: I see. That sounds quite reasonable.
transcript.zh: 明白了，听起来很合理

transcript.en: The details are all in our conference pack, which I'll send you.
transcript.zh: 详情都在我们的会议资料里，我会寄给你。

transcript.en: Great, thanks. That'll be very useful.
transcript.zh: 好的 谢谢，这很有用

transcript.en: Oh, and can you also send me an application form?
transcript.zh: 你能再发我一份申请表吗？

transcript.en: Of course. I'll get that in the post to you straight away.
transcript.zh: 没问题。我立刻寄给你。

transcript.en: Is there anything else?
transcript.zh: 还有什么需要帮忙的吗？

transcript.en: Yes, actually. Can you tell me where exactly the conference centre is?
transcript.zh: 有，你能告诉我会议中心的具体地址吗？

transcript.en: Well, it's on South Park Road and it's right at the end of the road next to the library.
transcript.zh: 它在南方公园路的尽头，挨着图书馆。

transcript.en: It's a ten-minute taxi ride from the station and will cost you ￡5.
transcript.zh: 从车站打车要花费十分钟时间，车费是5英镑。

transcript.en: Otherwise, you can take the bus which runs every half an hour from the station that's the 21A - and it brings you straight to the conference centre.
transcript.zh: 另外你可以在车站坐公交车来，每半小时发一班车，车号是21A。它会把你直接送到会议中心。好的。知道了。

transcript.en: Right, got that.
transcript.zh: 好的
